custom.name: Universal XH4 to four individual female sockets
custom.from: A/J2 LCD, A/J5 BH1750, A/J3 encoder; optional A/J4 TMP117
custom.to: Four independently movable female0.64mm-square-post sockets, numbered1..4
custom.finish: Standard individually insulated stranded copper wires. Number1..4 permanently at BOTH ends; no fixed GND/VCC function labels because encoder has a different map. Four independent1-position female sockets, ordinary crimp construction. No custom jacket, gauge transition, soldering or overmould. Harwin parts are dimensional/reference proposal; quote exact documented compatible lower-cost MPN separately if cheaper.
custom.approval: 30pcs base:10 LCD +10 BH1750 +10 encoder. Quote40pcs as an alternative total if TMP117 is populated; NOT30+40. Encoder sockets will be cut off locally, stripped and soldered with a common-ground bridge by the integrator (user accepted). TMP117 uses retail QW-4C male tails with numbered universal female sockets. No direct custom XH-SH needed.

FLY4.note: Four independent1-way housings, side-stackable on0.64mm square male posts. Supplier to confirm contact insulation OD/tooling. Label functions rather than assume LCD/GY302 physical order. Proposed documented replacement for generic Dupont, module engagement/clearance still needs real sample check.

length_definition: Flexible wire-path length between rear wire exits of connector housings, or solder joints/terminal shoulders for soldered ends. Includes fan-outs, branches and transitions along that path, excludes connector bodies and contacts. Supplier must state exact datum and physical tip-to-tip length on approval drawing; do not silently interpret as cut-wire length. 300mm is a quotation/service-loop proposal, actual routed fit unqualified.
inspection: 100percent continuity and unintended-short check, standard cavity labels and crimp pull/retention controls per connector specification. Supplier provides mating/wire-entry views and cavity1. No recurring special-label/custom-jacket/overmould operations. No customer crimping.
